provenance.note: Ratios only. Absolute RPS is not comparable across hosts; these are same-host, same-run ratios against Boehm. Recorded from the perf-smoke-report artifacts of the 23 green master runs on the headerless compile default (2026-09-10 e5bae04 through 2026-09-13 9f99142) — every green run since #41 flipped the layout, not the first ten. Ten was the plan and it under-sampled: a ten-run window read the spread as 96.6-105.2 on pct_json, while the thirteen runs after it ranged 93.9-108.4, which would have left the gate 0.94pp from a false alarm. At 23 runs no recording run sits outside its own tolerance on any metric (the previous recording had 1 of 10 on rss_x) and leave-one-out passes 23 of 23. The two predecessors were each invalidated by a default flip one release apart — 0.24.0's allocator, 0.26.0's layout — so the layout field above is load-bearing: perf_compare.py refuses to gate across a mismatch. Re-record on the next flip.
